entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. You've reached VeloFit, my name is Alex. How can I help you today?
Yeah, hi. I need to return something. My order number is VF789-011.
Certainly, I can help with that. Let me just pull up your order... VF789-011. I see the VeloBand Pulse, delivered 21 days ago. You'd like to return it?
Yes. It's just not what I expected. The heart rate tracking is inconsistent and it's uncomfortable. I want to send it back for a refund.
I see. Well, let's get that started for you. Our standard policy allows returns for up to 90 days, so you've got plenty of time.
Oh, 90 days? I was worried I was cutting it close. So there's no problem then?
Not at all. You're well within the return window, so don't worry. I'll just generate a return label for you now. One moment please.
Hmm. That's odd. The system isn't allowing me to proceed with the return authorization.
What do you mean? You just said I had plenty of time. What's the issue?

My sincere apologies. I am looking at a product-specific note now, and I was mistaken. I was referencing our general policy. The VeloBand Pulse, because it's a sensitive electronic device, actually has a strict 10-day return window. I am so sorry for that misinformation.
Are you kidding me? You just told me 'don't worry' and that the standard policy was 90 days! That's completely unacceptable. I would have called sooner if I knew that. This is your company's fault.
You are absolutely right to be upset, and I take full responsibility for my error. I gave you incorrect information, and I deeply apologize for the confusion and frustration this has caused.
So what now? I'm stuck with a $150 piece of gear I can't use because you read your own policy wrong?

While the system won't let me process a cash refund due to the 10-day policy being hard-coded, I am not going to leave you with a product you're unhappy with, especially when the error was mine. What I can do is issue a full store credit for the VeloBand Pulse's value.
Store credit? I just wanted my money back. I don't want to be forced to shop here again.

I completely understand your position. To further apologize for the inconvenience and my mistake, I can add an additional $25 credit to your account. That would give you a total of around $175 to use on any other VeloFit product, with no expiration date. It's the best I can do to make this right.
So... a full credit for the item plus an extra $25? For your mistake?
That's correct. I want to ensure you're taken care of.
Okay... fine. That's a reasonable solution. I appreciate you doing that.
Of course. I'm issuing that credit to your account now. You should receive an email confirmation within the next few minutes. Thank you for your patience and for allowing me to resolve this for you.
Thank you, Alex. I was pretty frustrated, but you handled it well. I appreciate it.
It was my pleasure. Is there anything else I can assist with today?
No, that's everything. Thanks again.
